scope: Executed E0 forward_action convolution/dense/attention MACs, one MAC equals two profiler FLOPs; independent module formulas plus explicit functional patch projection match each route. Excludes bias adds, normalization, nonlinearities, interpolation, ROI sampling, memory traffic, decoding and tracker bookkeeping. Route MACs are fixed-shape arithmetic counts, not dataset-weighted costs or measured FPS. Head-only M1/M2 costs exclude observer/collection/recovery. M2 initial two-modality anchor encoding counted separately, not per-frame. Smoke checkpoint proves architecture execution, not trained efficacy or completed integration. No process signalling or GPU allocation.
